subject: general
question: The salt satyagraha is notable for at least three reasons. Which of the following is not one of them?

options.text: the young population in India began to attend schools
It bought Mahatma Gandhi to the world's attention.
nationalist movement in which a large number of women participated.
The British had to realize that their monarchy would not last forever.

solution:
The correct answer is __**the young population in India began to attend schools X4 was the first.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The Salt March was notable for at least three reasons.**

 
 
• **First**, it was this event that first brought **Mahatma Gandhi **to **world attention** and was widely covered by the **European **and **American press**. Hence, **Statement 2 is correct.**
 
• **Second**, it was the** first nationalist activity** in which **women participated** in l**arge numbers**. Hence, **Statement 3 is correct.**
 
 
 
• The socialist activist** Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay** had persuaded **Gandhiji **not to restrict the protests to** men alone** and was herself one of the **numerous women** who **courted arrest** by breaking the** salt or liquor laws**.
 
 
• **Third**, and perhaps most significant, it was the **Salt March **which forced upon the **British **the realization that their **Raj would not last forever, **and that they would have to devolve some power to the Indians. Hence, S**tatement 4 is correct.**
 
 
 
• To that end, the **British government** convened a series of **Round Table Conferences** in **London**.
